on_complete.text: Pearls are sorted. Come by when you're free.

cards.label: Whitechapel — under a railway arch
cards.text: A train goes over and the whole arch hums. The sign above the roller door says REVERSE, with a clean pale patch in front of it where another word used to be.

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: "Gym. Mate of mine runs it." He ducks under the shutter. "Last night you stood there looking like a pain to fight. Time to be one. Don't ask about the sign."
Arnie is taping his knuckles: wide as the door, soft round the middle, forearms that don't match. "Dad bod," he says, before you've said anything. "Don't let it fool you."

cards.speaker: Arnie
cards.text: "Flip Reverse, it's called. After the Blazing Squad song. Flip fell off in a storm." He's grinning. "I once had a punch-up with two of the band outside a chippy. Best night of my life. Lost, mind."

cards.speaker: Arnie
cards.text: "House rules. There's a Rewind on the shelf, free, as many as you like. Go wrong, break it, go again. Walk out and I wind you back to the morning anyway. Leg it whenever you want. Nobody's marking you."
Arnie tosses you a pair of gloves. They're your size. Nobody asked him for your size.

intro: Mats down. Arnie rolls his shoulders.

lessons.1: His intent says Strike, twice. Pick Guard: while you're Guarded, a punch only chips you.
lessons.2: He's covering up, so a Strike would only chip him. Feint to knock his guard open, then Strike for the full hit.
lessons.3: He swings first, and swinging leaves him Open. Stun him while he's Open to take his next action, then Strike.

1.other.chip: Your guard took most of that. Guarded, you only lose a chip.
1.self.guard: Still Guarded for whatever he throws next.

2.other.guard: He's Guarded. Hit him now and you'd only chip him.
2.self.feint: He bit. He's Open, and his next Guard won't hold.
2.self.hit: Open, so it landed in full.

3.other.hit: You were Open after your last Strike, so that one landed in full.
3.self.stun: Stunned. He loses his next action.
3.other.lost: That was his Guard gone. He's still Open.
3.self.hit: Full damage. Nothing between him and it.

cards.speaker: Arnie
cards.text: He unwraps one hand and nods at you. "That's the whole job. Read what they're about to do, then do something about it. Now watch."
Arnie waves Archie onto the mats. Archie takes his jacket off and folds it.

cards.speaker: Arnie
cards.text: "Level five Feint. I open him up, cover myself, and hit back when he swings. Same move you've got, just more practice. Every move levels up the more you use it. First three sessions are on me. After that it's fifteen quid, and the rent on this place isn't cheap."

cards.speaker: Archie
cards.text: He pulls his jacket back on, checking his phone. "Told you. I've got your pearls to shift. I'll text you." He's through the shutter before you can thank him.
